member.summary: Atomically verifies if the current nonce matches the expected value, and if so, deletes it. This prevents TOCTOU (Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use) race conditions during concurrent proof replays. Implementation guarantees: - Redis: Uses Lua script for atomic compare-and-delete - EF Core: Uses single SQL DELETE WHERE statement - In-Memory: Uses ConcurrentDictionary with exact KeyValuePair matching

member.exception: Thrown if the store is unreachable.
